groups.scope: Cape Colony in its historical legal extent, including Pondoland and annexed British Bechuanaland. The Bechuanaland Protectorate, Basutoland, Natal, the Orange Free State and the South African Republic are outside this scope. Mafeking and Walfish Bay remain part of the Cape scope. The opening map places their points on the South African Republic and German South West Africa polygons respectively. The source month and day are unknown. The difference from the 1904 census cannot isolate wartime migration.

No new district boundary is inferred.

groups.method: Day-weighted linear interpolation between comparable enumeration endpoints, rounded to the nearest person. Each area is rounded independently. The census supplies no 1900 count or uncertainty interval. Famine and migration could change the timing of intercensal growth or decline.
groups.scope: Partition of the old India control using peer statistical areas in the 1891 comparison geography. Isolated frontier or enumeration differences stay in the residual. The source units have no WWO province polygons.
groups.uncertainty_kind: The unlocated remainder is an accounting residual with unknown geographic distribution and census error.

comparable_rows_left_out.reason: The Sikkim adjustment and external boundary prevent adopting the Bengal States comparison as a WWO subdivision.
The Kashmir return needs alignment of northern and eastern border jurisdictions. The General Report §53 records uncertainty in the jurisdiction areas.
The Punjab States comparison adjusts the later return and needs an opening boundary crosswalk on the northwest frontier.

balance_basis.scope: The implied balance includes published comparison areas held out and the arithmetic difference between the legacy and comparable controls. The source rounds the combined and component estimates independently. There is no measured 1900 population for the unenumerated remainder.

groups.locator: Section I, p. 1, island population at 31 March and increase during quarter

groups.locator: Bulletin 149, printed p. 16, Table 13 discussion, and Table 17, Philippine Islands

groups.uncertainty_kind: Intervening deaths and migration, military coverage and remote island scope are unquantified. The source reports no Philippines-specific uncertainty interval.
